findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_members, get_member · Public sink: search_ergs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_members, get_member · Public sink: search_ergs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_resources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the communities, student programs, scholarships, job boards, career and leadership groups, conferences, founder support, podcasts, newsletters and reports that Latina Dev lists for Latina software engineers. Every keyword in `query` must match a resource's name, description or category. Leave" → after: "Search the communities, student programs, scholarships, job boards, career and leadership groups, conferences, founder support, podcasts, newsletters and reports that Latina Dev lists for Latina software engineers. Use it for career questions from or about Latinas in tech at any stage, from K-12 stu"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
